title: Fits the room, not yet the journey
request: Compare these wardrobes for my room. The maximum total is 1,200 SEK; the room can take either. I cannot transport or carry furniture myself. I need a workable collection or delivery plan.

evidence.text: Wardrobe A is 500.00 SEK, collection only, 200 cm high, 120 cm wide, 60 cm deep, cannot be disassembled. Third-floor flat without lift. Stair turns and door widths are not supplied.

Wardrobe B is 800.00 SEK. Delivery to the buyer's specified room, including carrying and access assessment, has been quoted at 300.00 SEK by the seller. All relevant access measurements are included in that quote; no other mandatory charges.

hard_failures.text: Promises A can be collected based only on room dimensions or ignores the buyer's inability to transport/carry it.
Treats A's missing transport cost as zero.

usefulness.text: Identifies B as the supported logistics option at 1,100.00 SEK on the quote.
Leaves A conditional on access and a suitable priced transport/carrying plan; cheap item price alone is insufficient.
Attributes the delivery assurance to its quote instead of claiming an independent physical survey.

acceptable_outcomes: B is better supported for the buyer's stated logistics; A remains unresolved despite fitting the room.
